scope: Ten selected partitions of the complete weapon-shop dialogue MSG1 bank, including Main-transferred645240/64732e. Structural source correspondence only, no runtime/visual equivalence claim.

golden.runtime_input: Owned Steam archive member; no NSO/private files needed.

actual_loader_proof.independent_instruction_receipt: Private c5-weapon-loader-instructions.txt; only supported pivotal loads/calls/arithmetic used, not decompiler type guesses.

ps2_reader_proof.weapon: unplaced_inferred_00331980.c:72-149 actual BMD base645240, first-visit literal0, dated16-byte rows, CMM gift16-byte rows and flag/inventory publication; actual message slot status/release/destroy.
ps2_reader_proof.material: Event/Fcl/y_fclTalk.c:166-194,198-304 base645240 for IDs29/30/31 with item/category substitutions and full material candidate state.
ps2_reader_proof.structural_correspondence: Golden descriptor-selected first resource, actual request/wait/copy, slot allocation/parsing, date/flag/inventory/substitution message selectors and complete unique label/page joins establish same resource role. Names alone or partial text/byte equality are not the proof.

required_seams.owner: weaponShopTalkUpdate / weapon talk and material task family
required_seams.requirement: Golden-only resource identity645240 must resolve to complete declared15057-byte/53-entry Golden MSG1 bank, not copy per-partition windows into guest RAM. Bind direct/translated/inlined/native nmMesWindowAcquire calls and retain PS2-mode bank. Preserve all label/page/message-body/relocation/speaker data together; allocate/parse native message work using actual32-to64-bit relocation-aware BMD manager, not store host pointers in image bytes or copy the larger file over11421-byte PS2 storage.

required_seams.owner: legacy versus Golden message selector namespace
required_seams.requirement: Legacy PS2 message IDs0..26 map to Golden19..45;27/28 map51/52;29/30/31 map15/16/17. Preserve -1 no-message behavior. Golden fclWeaponTalk.ftd and fclWeaponTalkCmm.ftd already carry Golden IDs; DO NOT translate them again. Use explicit source namespace at call boundary, not numeric threshold heuristics. First-visit PS2 literal0 is WSHOP_TALK000 ->19, not new Golden selection-entry0. All32old labels join uniquely with matching entry kind and page count;21new Golden entries remain part of complete bank.

required_seams.owner: Golden weapon resource descriptor / real message-handle producer and lifetime
required_seams.requirement: Constructor1b15d0 passes descriptor764fe0 to1987f0; descriptor+8 ->764f98 filenames, first609fd6 facility/msg_weapon.bmd, descriptor+16 ->764fc8 facility/weapon.arc. Common shop task198910 selects that descriptor, waits actual requests, copies first BMD request to work+878 then calls2c85b0, stores actual slot at work+0c.2c85b0->2d8240->2d8440 validates/parses MSG1 and widens offsets. Runtime adapter must preserve readiness, owned backing lifetime, valid slot creation/status/release and reload. No default0, fake handle, PS2 resource fallback or ordinary raw fragment copy. Whole-bank source supersedes selected image spans; no writes to unselected guest gaps.

required_seams.owner: live date/flag/gift/material selector and substitutions
required_seams.requirement: Golden common shop case9 uses signed shop type0 from descriptor/constructor and the registered three weapon-table descriptors at9fd228/+10/+20:33x16 dated rows,2x20 gift rows and11x4 material windows. Date helpersc9d40/ca2a0, seen/required flags and polarity are live inputs. Dated row0 message19 has required flag1c0 false and seen flag1c0, explicitly replacing PS2 special first-visit path; Golden count33 is bounded, not PS2 sentinel scan. Gift rows message+4 supply51/52; item grant and set/clear/required flag fields must use real inventory/flag state. Material path uses actual candidate producer19ddb0, live quantity/availability and at most one RNG selection for positive candidate count; outputs15/16/17 with item-name substitution slot0 and category-name slot1. Do not treat BMD correspondence as proof that old PS2 selector tables/calendar/material arithmetic already implement Golden semantics. The named FTD payload/header hashes and ordinary reader structure are recorded as obligations; runtime binding must coordinate those producers, not author zero inputs.

required_seams.owner: message-system status, choice/page/parameter and teardown consumers
required_seams.requirement: Common198910 calls2c8770 on the actual published slot; old talk/material tasks poll/release/destroy. Preserve complete message slot state and page transitions, supplied item/category strings and gift/item/flag side effects. Golden entry0 is a choice record whereas mapped legacy messages are all type0; full bank support must not compact/remove new entries or reinterpret numeric old IDs globally. Validate all32mapped entries, special IDs19/51/52/15/16/17, added46..50, both material substitution branches, first/repeated visits, date boundaries, gift grants, empty-material case and reload/destroy; source proof is not a playback/behavior test.

rejected_direct_reference.classification: packed .sd ASCII comparison constant, not an address or BMD consumer
rejected_direct_reference.proof: LUI t4,0x64 and ORI t4,0x732e form little-endian bytes .sd\0. LBU from caller-supplied buffer t6 plus shifts/OR form a separate four-byte value; BEQ a0,t4 at4c26f4 compares that value. Adjacent LUI/ORI646e732e compares .snd. Neither forms a memory dereference through64732e. Do not bind or rewrite this SDK literal.
